a: Profit comes last, so it gets ignored

a: Five
Three
Seven
Ten

questions.q: What should you do with the profit and tax accounts?
a: Keep them out of sight, ideally at other banks
Check their balances every morning
Use them as a backup for urgent bills
Combine them to reduce account fees
questions.why: Lesson 2 says hiding those accounts, at separate banks, helps you resist the temptation to break your rules.
